note: Factory kill switch. enabled=false pauses production mutations (claims, QA, publish) but keeps safety operations available: --recover, --consistency, writer-lock status/acquire/release, checkpoints, --progress. There is NO scheduled/AI cron anywhere in this repository (test_no_cron_anywhere enforces it), so the former scheduled_runs_enabled flag was dead configuration and has been removed. A paused factory with a pending transaction can always be recovered via --recover. chunk_size = 2 is the bounded production micro-pair contract (owner-approved 2026-10-01): a NEW push may claim at most 2 fresh article IDs (scripts/factory_push_selection.py refuses more; MAX_CLAIM=50 stays only as a defensive hard ceiling in code). BACKLOG recovery is capped at chunk_size too. REPAIR pushes of already-claimed rows are not capped by chunk_size.
